Remark
[closed subgroups and right-invariant metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0226 ↗ rem:pet-ch5-quotient-homogeneous For $K\subset H$ merely closed, right multiplication by $K$ is still a proper action, made isometric by a right-$K$-invariant metric on $H$; but it may not be possible to simultaneously keep the metric on $H$ left-invariant, so $H$ need not act by isometries on $H/K$ in this more general case.
